answer: Agents bond stake to an epoch-specific polynomial identity commitment and prove, through Semaphore membership and RLN proofs, that each message uses a valid rate-limit nullifier. Reusing a nullifier yields distinct Shamir shares; anyone can combine them to recover the signing secret and verify the violation, triggering instantaneous collateral slashing. The quill records proofs, copper anchors commitments, and a ledge bounds each agent’s permitted message rate.
